artDirection: Simple transparent enemy busts; purple rim light for undead, orange-yellow for demons, crimson for the Assassins' Guild; the Vault Tyrant uses amber-red.

portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production enemy portrait for the dark fantasy browser game Vaultbound. Create a SINGLE centered head-and-shoulders, upper chest bust on a real transparent background. Frontal view with a subtle three-quarter turn, entire head and any horns contained with a little safe margin. Match illustrated fantasy hero portraits: dimensional painterly forms, navy-black shadows, restrained tactile materials, clear soft neutral frontal lighting. SIMPLER than a hero portrait: a few bold color masses, minimal equipment and decoration, no tiny engravings, readable face and role silhouette even as a 32 pixel icon. The head should be large in the frame; shoulders fill the bottom, clean cutout edges. Subject: An ivory skeleton soldier with a plain chipped iron kettle helmet and ragged dark cloth over narrow bony shoulders. Clearly readable bare skull, hollow eye sockets, no gore. Lighting: Violet / purple rim backlight around the silhouette; bone stays ivory and flesh remains desaturated. Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no scenery, no circular badge or frame, no full body, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no gore.
